spans.s:
दैतेय दैतेय, अस्, m. (fr. दिति), a son of
Diti, an Asura, an enemy of the gods, (especially)
epithet of Rāhu; (अस्, ई, अम्), proceeding from or
belonging to the Daiteyas.

दैत्य, अस्, m. a son of Diti, a demon; (अस्, आ,
अम्), belonging or relating to the Daityas; (आ), f. a
kind of fragrant plant (= मुरा); a perfume; a drug
(= चण्डौषधि); spirituous liquor.
—दैत्य-
गुरु, उस्, m. ‘the preceptor of the Daityas,’ an
epithet of Śukra, the regent of the planet Venus.
—दैत्य-दानव-मर्दन, अस्, m. ‘subduer or
crusher of Daityas and Dānavas,’ a title of Indra.
—दैत्य-देव, अस्, m. ‘the god of the Daityas,’
an epithet of Varuṇa, deity of the waters; Air or Wind
personified.
—दैत्य-द्वीप, अस्, m. ‘refuge or pro-
tector of the Daityas (?),’ N. of a son of Garuḍa.
—दैत्य-निसूदन, अस्, m. ‘the destroyer of the
Daityas,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu.
—दैत्य-प, अस्, or
दैत्य-पति, इस्, m. ‘the prince of the Daityas,’ epi-
thet of Bali.
—दैत्य-पुरोधस्, आस्, or दैत्य-पु-
रोहित, or दैत्य-पूज्य, अस्, m. ‘family priest of the
Daityas, to be honoured by them,’ epithet of Śukra,
regent of Venus.
—दैत्य-मातृ, ता, f. ‘mother
of the Daityas,’ epithet of Diti.
—दैत्य-मेद-
ज, अस्, m. ‘produced from the marrow of a Daitya,’
a kind of bdellium (= भूमिज-गुग्गुलु); (आ), f.
the earth (supposed to be produced from the Meda
or marrow of the Daityas Madhu and Kaiṭabha).
—दैत्य-युग, अम्, n. an age of the demons
(consisting of 12000 divine years or the sum of the
four Yugas or ages of man).
—दैत्य-सेना, f., N.
of a daughter of Prajā-pati and sister of Deva-senā.
—दैत्यारि (˚य-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of the
Daityas,’ an epithet of Viṣṇu; a god in general.
—दैत्याहोरात्र (˚य-अह्˚), अस्, m. a day and
night of the demons (being a year of mortals).
—दैत्येज्य (˚य-इज्˚), अस्, m. ‘preceptor of the
Daityas,’ an epithet of Śukra who is the regent of
Venus; [cf. दैत्य-गुरु.]
—दैत्येन्द्र (˚य-इन्˚),
अस्, m. ‘a prince of the Daityas,’ an epithet of
Pātāla-ketu.
—दैत्येन्द्र-पूज्य, अस्, m. ‘to be
honoured by the chief of the Daityas,’ an epithet
of Śukra, regent of Venus.
